task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the NYSE is open, look up AAPL’s current price, and if it’s available use that quote to sell 10 shares of AAPL. Then get the current New York time, post the update to my US market board with high priority, and after that create a Trade Execution Report with the execution time and email me the notification.

user_input.query: Please check whether the NYSE is open, then look up the current price for AAPL. If a quote is available, use it to sell 10 shares of AAPL for trader_id user_99, and note the currency as EUR. After that, get the current New York time and post an update to my US market board, board_id poly_01, with high priority. Then create a Trade Execution Report that includes the execution time, and email me the notification as well.
